messages:
alex: Quick sync—I'm reserving a 2-week runway to onboard 'Aurora-lite' variants. Proposal: minimal smoke + canary cohort (5% of traffic), bench slice pass thresholds, pin TTL 30 days for customers that opt-in. Thoughts?
maria: Sounds reasonable. For benches propose: latency P95 <= 220ms on our medium hw slice, accuracy regression <= 1.5% on our standard eval set.
sam: Where does the fallback go if regression detected? Auto-fallback to previous pinned model or serve smaller variant?
jordan: We should prefer auto-fallback to pinned version for customer continuity; add a 'grace degrade' variant for cost sensitive tenants.
taylor: Agree. Also need an explicit list of ticket types in runway: infra smoke, perf bench, eval pass, canary rollout, comms + opt-in toggle.
alex: I'll draft ticket checklist. Quick question @maria: bench sampling size? 2k queries per slice?
maria: 2k should give decent CI, but for rare-case latents bump to 5k for P95 confidence. Use 2k for regional quick-pass, 5k for global gate.
sam: :eyes: need to confirm there are no quantization mismatches for older checkpoints. Add a preflight `kv-cache` integrity test.
alex: Noted. Adding `kv-cache` check to infra smoke: command we run locally:
```
./bench/run.sh --model aurora-lite-v1 --slice medium --samples 2000
```
Also `./tools/kv-check --model aurora-lite-v1`
release-bot: deploy job aurora-lite-smoke #42: SUCCESS :white_check_mark: (started by alex at 2024-03-21T10:12Z)
jordan: Can we define the 'softland protocol' for deprecations? e.g., 30d pin TTL, 14d customer notice, 2-week rollback window.
taylor: Add SLA for rollback time: <= 4 hours to revert canary if severe. Ops must have `rollback` playbook updated.
alex: Owners: infra smoke (sam), perf benches (maria), canary rollout + comms (jordan), rollback playbook (taylor). I'll open the tickets now and tag owners. Target: start benching tomorrow, canary next Wed. :shipit:
maria: SGTM. I'll queue perf runs and post results in the ticket. cc @release-bot for any deploy hooks.
